verdict.rationale: Adyen supports several background/event-driven automations — webhooks that eliminate manual polling for async status changes, Uplift's AI-driven payment-funnel optimization experiments that can be started/evaluated/stopped autonomously, and risk-management rules/ML fraud detection that run continuously — but these are fixed platform features rather than a general-purpose mechanism for an AI-native user to author custom autonomous background automations. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation/workflow builder or scheduler that an AI-native user can set up to run arbitrary agentic tasks unattended, and independent evidence of such automations running reliably in production.
